prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A small ink glyph — simple open circle with a centered dot, the
universal "mark, notice" sigil. Parchment-tone ink.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor on aged parchment, a single minimalist notice glyph centered on warm vellum cream, punctuated by deep slate ink.

subjects.description: Open circle with centered dot, bold clean stroke weight, notice sigil, crisp ink linework on parchment ground.
Aged parchment surface, faint foxing at edges, warm vellum texture beneath the glyph.
